unresolved_contract_gaps.title: RG-10 operation effects, fixture transitions, and complete retries
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The closed registry owns the 13 RG-10 action tokens, exact class/outcome dispatch, closed inputs, sparse attempted_input, and generic rejected/no-change atomicity. It does not execute RG-10 domain failure predicates, reason_code/field_path selection, fixture transitions, economic effects, lifecycle changes, returned IDs, or complete idempotent retries.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Add fixture-backed operation prototypes with domain failure predicates, exact reason_code/field_path selection, exhaustive effect signatures, economic and lifecycle invariants, returned IDs, and same-action retry verification before opening adapter or expected-output gates.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Open inputs or generic retries would weaken atomic rejection, pending-confirmation, and idempotency guarantees.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Stored-value lot, consumption, allocation, and expiry lifecycle payloads
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: Only the minimal stored_value_lot payload is registered; remaining face value, paid/bonus composition, consumption, allocation, expiry, rename, and lifecycle history are not closed.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register append-only lot, consumption, allocation, expiry, and rename payloads with stable identity, evidence, deterministic ordering, and no composition inference.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Collapsing lifecycle facts into postings or relations would lose allocation provenance and permit unaudited inference.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Stored-value import source, candidate, confirmation, and provenance payloads
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: Current v2 lacks closed RG-10 source, recharge/spend candidate, confirmation-subject, and audit payload branches needed to preserve pending intake and explicit confirmation provenance.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register typed pending-confirmation intake, source-specific evidence payloads, explicit confirmation subjects, and append-only provenance without formal auto-booking.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Treating imported facts as formal postings would authorize automatic confirmation or collapse source evidence into ledger facts.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Activation boundary and replace-not-append reconstruction semantics
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: Current v2 owns the closed reconstruction identity, endpoint topology, typed audit links, active-mode history, and append-only invariants, but no operation or replay path applies the selected economic owner.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register activation and reconstruction operations, enforce selected-owner exclusivity in formal replay, and migrate the frozen fixture and expected outputs.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: A plain adjustment cannot prevent duplicate effects when real history replaces it.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Category parent identity migration
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: Stored-value account configuration and all three system roles now have current v2 owners. The frozen fixture still supplies only numeric category level and no parent category identity.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Provide an explicit sanitized category parent mapping before level 2 can map to the current parent_id owner; never infer parent identity from level alone.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Without these six contract additions, stored-value capability and merchant restrictions cannot be validated, the level-2 category has no approved parent identity, and all three frozen stored-value system roles remain outside the closed enum.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Bonus-component and expiry-confirmation evidence roles and domain targets
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: Current v2 owns bonus and expiry domain facts plus their exact typed evidence links, but the legacy link status has no current business-evidence verification owner.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register evidence-verification state and operations independently from expiry economic confirmation; do not map business evidence status to posting reconciliation.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Reusing the lot role would create duplicate lot evidence, while targeting a transaction or posting would incorrectly grant financial reconciliation authority.
